verdict.rationale:
Algolia publishes a well-documented public REST Search API with explicit authentication headers, official client libraries for 9+ languages, a CLI, and an MCP server/agent-skills pack for driving operations programmatically or via AI agents. Runtime probes confirm the CLI works keylessly and the hosted MCP server is live and speaks OAuth/MCP protocol, corroborating first-party docs.

missing for 10: no discoverable OpenAPI/Swagger spec (all candidate paths 404), and no independent hands-on API-quality corroboration beyond CLI/MCP probes.
